    );

    if (!dialog) {
      const dialogContent = dialogContainer.content.cloneNode(true);

      dialog = dialogContent.querySelector(

      if (!dialog) {
        throw Error(`No such dialog with id: ${dialogId} exists!`);
      }

      dialogContainer.insertAdjacentElement('afterend', dialog);

      dialog.show();
